# Mixergy for Home Assistant

> Home Assistant custom integration for Mixergy smart hot water tanks. It reads the tank through Mixergy's cloud API (www.mixergy.io) and gives Home Assistant live charge and temperatures, a hot water boost, an optional native water heater entity, PV diverter monitoring and controls, holiday scheduling, Energy dashboard sensors and per-tank services. Installed through HACS as a custom repository. Requires Home Assistant 2025.8 or newer. MIT licensed. Independent project, not made or endorsed by Mixergy.

## Install

1. In HACS, add https://github.com/CaputoDavide93/Mixergy-Home-Assistant as a custom repository of type Integration, download Mixergy, restart Home Assistant.
2. Settings, Devices and services, Add integration, Mixergy. Sign in with the email address and password of your Mixergy app account and pick your tank.
3. Choose Simple (sensors and a boost slider) or Advanced (full control surface). The mode can be changed later from the Configure button.

## Key facts

- Domain: `mixergy_tank`. One config entry and one device per tank, several tanks supported.
- Cloud polling only: no local API on the tank, so no internet means no data. Poll interval 30 to 300 seconds, default 60.
- Services: `mixergy_tank.set_holiday_dates`, `mixergy_tank.clear_holiday_dates`, `mixergy_tank.boost_charge`. All accept entity, device or area targets.
- Energy: cumulative electric and PV kWh sensors for the Energy dashboard, plus an optional cost sensor when a price per kWh is set.
- Alerts: configurable low and no hot water binary sensors, a tank connectivity sensor and device triggers.
- Privacy: credentials stay in the Home Assistant config entry; requests go to mixergy.io over verified TLS only; no telemetry.
- Languages: English, German, French, Italian.

## Tested on

- The minimum supported and the current Home Assistant (see the CI matrix): test suite in CI, plus hassfest and HACS validation.
- One tank run live by the maintainer: indirect (gas or oil) heating, firmware 7.2.1.
- Electric immersion, heat pump and PV diverter tanks: handled in code and unit tests with sample API responses, unverified on hardware. Reports welcome: https://github.com/CaputoDavide93/Mixergy-Home-Assistant/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
